{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''faction''' of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fought against a [[Dark Jedi faction (Doomed)|faction]] of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] after crash landing there sometime after [[6900 BBY]]. The rival groups fought one another on the world, but their actions brought untold harm to the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Species/Legends|species]], an event that came to be know as the [[Great Calamity]]. All but one combatant, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Remulus Dreypa]], agreed to end the hostilities for the sake of the Keshiri. For his recalcitrance, Dreypa was sealed in an [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|oubliette]]. The remaining [[The Force/Legends|Force]] users merged their ranks to form [[the Doomed]], taking it as their task to watch over the Keshiri.
